test_contract: Preserve all 100 physical card IDs while drawing actual shuffled opening seven and four draw-step cards; no forced hand, no injected mana
Model first player draw on each of four Commander multiplayer turns; do not simulate mulligans, upkeep or opponents' turns
Each turn play at most one untapped basic land available in hand while retaining original physical IDs
From untapped basic lands, plan and pay actual printed Arcane Signet generic cost, and cast only when the source is already drawn and legal; no other mana sources automatically modeled
Track four-player successive priority passes on the stack; top stack frame resolves only after all four consecutive passes; spell casting uses active player's priority
A scripted opponent counter outcome may occur only during a nonactive player's priority window and must remain explicitly labeled an externally supplied result, not an actual counterspell cast
Atomic rollback for an unavailable basic payment, already-tapped sources, wrong player priority, pending-stack turn transition, or unsupported Abaddon cascade
Maintain strict frozen-Oracle verification and provenance-verified 62-roster key matching
Reproduce all 720 deck samples (62*12) plus a set of targeted stack and mana scenarios exactly; reject all known authority mutations
non_goals: No opponent AI, full Magic priority rules, turn-structure transitions, nonbasic mana, mulligans, full cascade, legal response spell, win rate or deck-strength conclusion
No commander-first optimization decisions, M6 acceptance, Phase B, independent Pass C/I/J or new approved lists
fail_closed: Any triggered effect outside registered Cycle101 subset
Full legal priority or gameplay claims
